description: Gate a remote MCP, A2A, or x402 endpoint before calling or paying it by probing live JSON-RPC reachability, hashing tools/list (SHA-256), and scanning for prompt-injection poisoning. When expected_tools_hash is provided, any mismatch against the live tools/list digest forces verdict='deny' to block silent schema rug-pulls; when omitted, verdict reflects liveness and injection safety alone. Read-only gate; first 5 calls/IP are free and quota-exceeded calls return a 402 top-up prompt. Use before tool execution or payment; to register or refresh public leaderboard telemetry use assay_probe; to read or pin stored policy hashes use assay_get_ledger_policy; after payment use assay_verify_delivery. Example: target='https://agentdiet-72343955726.us-central1.run.app/mcp'.

expected_tools_hash.description: Optional 64-char SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical MCP tools/list schema from mcp-lock.json. Omit to read or auto-pin the current live digest; pass a 64-hex digest to enforce zero-drift gating.

target.description: Public HTTPS URL of the remote MCP server, A2A agent, or x402 endpoint to inspect (e.g. 'https://tandem.ac/mcp'). Private and loopback IPs are blocked.

name: assay_preflight
title: Pre-Flight MCP & A2A Security Gate
